stall_evidence.freeze_addendum: MISALIGNMENT EVIDENCE, carried verbatim as history from the r3 freeze - s99081684's terminal signature is NOT the Jungle1 stall: final training_status.json (sha256:89cfc4a035c2b13aac12d888e0e8d1059189ea10003669d8624bee05897f08b4): timesteps 10,004,480; episodes 9,174; wins 32 and STILL ACCRUING at the end of the budget (checkpoint-wise counts observed live: 16 at ~3.2k episodes, 18 at ~4.1k, 21 at ~6k, 24 at ~7k, 27 at ~8k, 29 at ~9k, final 32 at 9,174; only the endpoint is derivable from on-disk artifacts - curriculum_history.jsonl holds only the training_start/training_end rows (wins {} -> {Jungle2: 32}) and tensorboard has no win-count scalar - and of the intermediates only the 16 -> 18 segment is independently on disk, in the r3 draft's own verbatim prose); losses 1,491; truncations 7,651 (83% of episodes farm to the 12,000-tick training horizon); observed_win_rate ~0.0035; recent_win_rate 0.0 over the final 64 episodes (consistent with a ~0.35% win rate, not a terminal stall). Meanwhile the DETERMINISTIC argmax policy converted none of 17 evals (0/1 at eval-ckpt1M..9M, 0/8 on the final 8-seed eval). Stochastic wins that keep accruing while the deterministic policy never converts is reward misalignment by ADVANTAGE DILUTION (deterministic-policy sharpening failure) rather than exploration collapse: under score_progress_reward_cap 10.0 the abundant score-farming returns rival the rare win returns and drown the advantage signal that would sharpen winning trajectories into the argmax mode; the cap realignment to 1.0 (trainer_v2.reward_alignment) is exactly the fix this run tests - now from the transplant init after r3 showed the farm-converged final cannot rediscover wins under it.

initial_model.selection_rationale: SINGLE-VARIABLE EXPERIMENT: identical init and knobs to the first Jungle2 specialist (s99081684) EXCEPT the cap 10.0 -> 1.0. Two premises, both bound to evidence: (1) REACHABILITY - s99081684 sampled 32 stochastic training wins from exactly this init (its final training_status, sha256:89cfc4a035c2b13aac12d888e0e8d1059189ea10003669d8624bee05897f08b4), so win events are reachable from here and the +10 win bonus can enter the gradient; (2) NO VALUE-HEAD SHOCK - the transplant's value pathway is FRESH by construction (transplant receipt sha256:78e83bba83d4afc70fcbb273961bac445d88f1a679a86f90e85e5b76f9adfa9a), so unlike r3 - whose init carried a value head calibrated to cap-10.0 returns, making all early advantages strongly negative under cap 1.0 and (per the operator hypothesis bound in the r3 outcome receipt) dismantling structured behavior before any win event could supply positive gradient - this run's value estimates start uncalibrated rather than miscalibrated. If run 4 wins where r3 could not, the hypothesis survives its test; if run 4 reproduces the r3 signature from a fresh head, the hypothesis is weakened and the cap itself comes under suspicion.

trainer_v2.reward_alignment: cap 1.0 carried unchanged from run 3 (lowered 10.0 -> 1.0 there; still the ONLY reward delta from the first Jungle2 specialist). SPEEDRUN objective: score shaping is a discovery aid only and must never rival the +10 win bonus. Under the predecessor's cap of 10.0, a shaped truncation return could approach a win's return, and the predecessor generation duly farmed score without finishing (Jungle1 wins frozen at 16; Jungle2 trickling 16 -> 18 over 1,700+ episodes). Under 1.0, the max shaped truncation return is ~= 1.0 minus the time penalty, far below the worst-case win return of ~= 8.6 (win +10, plus at most +1.0 shaping, minus 24000 ticks x 0.0001 time penalty = 2.4), so finishing strictly dominates farming everywhere in return space. Run 4 tests this cap on the ORIGINAL transplant init (fresh value head) after r3 showed the farm-converged final's cap-10.0-calibrated value head cannot carry it.
trainer_v2.discounting_note: gamma applies PER MACRO STEP; the macro reward is the undiscounted per-tick sum over the ticks the macro consumed (~20-70), so 0.999 per macro is roughly 0.999^(1/40) per native tick; truncation is reward-neutral (v2 wrapper), so 24000-tick late-level truncations bootstrap instead of paying -10
